name: industrial-power-plants
title: Industrial Power Plants
author: Claude
description: Industrial combined-cycle gas power stations (fuel-gas conditioner, gas turbine, heat-recovery steam generator, large steam turbine) a pressurized-water nuclear plant with circuit-controlled control rods and a sodium-cooled fast breeder with a supercritical-CO2 power cycle, built on native fusion-generator turbines (fluid in, electricity and fluid out). Requires Space Age.
